subject: Pause the showcase until sample ingest + dry-run complete
messages:
From: Samantha Byrne <samantha@finlytics.com>

Cc: eng@finlytics.com
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proof-of-concept kickoff — sample data & SSO access

Hi Ava and David,

Thanks again for the quick intro earlier. We had penciled the PoC showcase for Nov 18 (90 mins) with our product and infra teams. Two things came up on our side: our lead engineer needs to travel that week, and our security lead asked for an SSO health check before any demo that touches live traces.

Before we confirm a time, can you confirm the following artifacts are in place?
- a short sample dataset (PII redacted) we can ingest (CSV/Parquet)
- a short workload trace (API logs or token distribution) for the 5–10k token flows
- SSO/SCIM test user + SP metadata for a staging tenant
- a 60–90 minute dry-run slot the week prior for a tech dry-run

I attached the sample-ingest-specs.xlsx that we intended to use as input. If any of these items are missing, we'd prefer to shift the showcase until they're ready. We want the session to be a working demo — not a slide deck — so having the ingest and SSO set will make it productive.

Proposed fallback dates if we delay: Nov 22 or Nov 29 (both look workable for our execs). Let me know what works.

Thanks,
Samantha Byrne
Director, Platform Integrations
FinLytics

Samantha — thanks for the context and the attachment. Quick read-through and a proposed plan from our side:

Summary of what we need to validate before running the 90-minute showcase:
- Confirm sample data format + size (CSV or Parquet, < 500 MB)
- Provide a short workload trace and peak token distribution (we only need a 15–30 minute window of representative traffic)
- Share SSO metadata (SP entity ID, ACS URL, cert) for a staging tenant or create a test user via SCIM
- Agree on a dry-run window (we recommend 90 minutes for the internal run to exercise fallbacks and batching)

Given the travel and security asks on your side, we recommend pausing the public-facing showcase until we complete the ingest + dry-run. If you want to keep a placeholder on Nov 18 we can — but we think a firm date after the dry-run will ensure a smooth session and minimize exec time.

Proposed timeline (from our engineering/ops availability):
- Nov 10–12: engineering ingest validation and prompt-set generation
- Nov 15: internal 90-minute dry-run with canary traffic (Ava, David, Lauren)
- Nov 22: customer-facing showcase (contingent on dry-run success)

Action items for FinLytics: share the trace and SSO metadata by Nov 9. If you need help extracting the workload trace we can send a short script.

If the Nov 22 date is tight, Nov 29 is our second choice.

Regards,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Ava Chen
Redwood Inference

From: david_kim <david@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proof-of-concept kickoff — sample data & SSO access

Samantha — echoing Ava. Given the travel and the security gate, please consider this a request to pause the public showcase until the required artifacts are in our staging tenant. We want the live run to include prefix caching and our canary fallback so that we can validate both quality and cost metrics.

Concrete asks from Redwood: 
1) Sample dataset (PII redacted) uploaded to the Drive link you provided by COB Nov 9.
2) Workload trace (best-effort) or a short synthetic capture; we only need token-length distribution and top 10 call patterns.
3) SSO/SP metadata or a test SCIM user in the staging tenant by Nov 9.
4) If possible, grant our engineer (david@redwood.ai) admin access to the staging tenant for the dry-run window.

We will schedule a 90-minute internal dry-run on Nov 15 at 10:00 PST. Lauren will coordinate the calendar invite and the runbook; she's cc'd. We will attach the canary_run_checklist.pdf to that invite and follow a runbook: ingest -> prompt-set validation -> canary traffic -> metrics review -> rollback/fallback test.

If FinLytics prefers Nov 22 for the external showcase, we can hold that as a hard target, otherwise Nov 29 is fine.

Thanks — short note from Lauren once invites are out is appreciated.

-David
